family: # assets/families.example.tsv: who is related to whom, for steps 38 and 39.
# One row per sample you sequence (or will), tab separated. The family column
# groups the rows into families; each family gets its own folder,
# GENOME_DIR/<family>/, so a family name follows the sample-name rule and is
# no person's name. Leave the column out for a single family (the file then
#   father, mother  the sample's parents: a sample of the same family, or a
#                   name with no row of its own for a parent not sequenced
#   partner         the other parent of the sample's children, or a partner
#   a child         is a row whose father and/or mother are filled
#   sex             male, female or unknown ('.' for unknown)
# '.' or an empty field means not known. A person is in one family, and the
# parents and partner a row names are in that same family.
